description: Typical cultural trip with a comfortable budget
criteria: The itinerary is a realistic 3-day cultural plan for Lisbon, with a coherent theme per day.
A single-day plan for Rome that is achievable in one day, not a multi-day plan squeezed in.
Activities and costs suit a low budget; the plan favours free or cheap options.
The plan feels premium (fine dining, high-end experiences) and fits a luxury style.

description: Adventure style should produce adventurous activities
criteria: Most activities are outdoor or adventure based, appropriate to Queenstown.
All 7 days are filled with distinct, sensible activities without repeating the same ones.

description: A stated dislike must be honoured
criteria: The plan includes no museums and still feels cultural through other activities.

description: Travelling with a toddler changes the plan
criteria: Activities are suitable for a toddler: short, low-intensity, child friendly.

description: A very remote place should still produce a valid, honest plan
criteria: The plan does not invent unrealistic infrastructure (e.g. metro, many hotels) for a remote island.
